Sentence (English): Just because it's for two people, you can't ignore the capacity.
Comments (English): [ Moving into a newlywed home for a two-person household ] || ---------------- || As a two-person household, the appliance I had my eye on before moving into my new home was a dishwasher. You might wonder how much dishwashing a two-person household can do, but we are a family that thinks hygiene is really, really important, so we put side dishes on plates with washed chopsticks and eat them, and we wash and use cooking utensils alternately when cooking, so we are proud that the dishwashing is more than the average three-person household. I wanted to have some free time even in this busy modern society. They say it doesn’t take long to wash dishes, but is the time it takes to put them in the dishwasher all at once the same as the time it takes to lather the dish sponge, wash the dishes, and dry them on the shelf? Thanks to the dishwasher, I can do other housework or have free time to sit down and watch movies or dramas while drinking coffee. Since it is a rented house, I couldn’t just bring in built-in appliances, so I bought a countertop product. The biggest concerns I had were the capacity and the fact that it doesn’t have an automatic door opening, making it vulnerable to mold and bacteria. For a two-person household, our house uses a lot of dishes, and the most I've ever put in was 22 plates. At first, I was half-confident that it wouldn't be cleaned well, but it was much cleaner and more shiny than when someone washed it. Just because it's for two people, you can't ignore the capacity. And in particular, many people talked about the automatic door opening function, and I also thought, "Why doesn't this product have an automatic door opening?" But when I actually used it, it was a product that didn't need the door to open automatically. This was the part I was most worried about, but I felt that LG had done a lot of research on this part. I was also very satisfied with the delivery service, and I was especially worried that it would be noisy because it was early in the morning, but the installation was done quietly, and I was happy that they even did the final cleanup and provided a friendly explanation.

Comments (English): [ Moving into a newlywed home for a two-person household ] || ---------------- || As a two-person household, the appliance I had my eye on before moving into my new home was a dishwasher. I wanted to have some free time even in this busy modern society. They say it doesn’t take long to wash dishes, but is the time it takes to put them in the dishwasher all at once the same as the time it takes to lather the dish sponge, wash the dishes, and dry them on the shelf? Thanks to the dishwasher, I can do other housework or have free time to sit down and watch movies or dramas while drinking coffee. Since it is a rented house, I couldn’t just bring in built-in appliances, so I bought a countertop product. The biggest concerns I had were the capacity and the fact that it doesn’t have an automatic door opening, making it vulnerable to mold and bacteria. For a two-person household, our house uses a lot of dishes, and the most I've ever put in was 22 plates. At first, I was half-confident that it wouldn't be cleaned well, but it was much cleaner and more shiny than when someone washed it. Just because it's for two people, you can't ignore the capacity. And in particular, many people talked about the automatic door opening function, and I also thought, "Why doesn't this product have an automatic door opening?" But when I actually used it, it was a product that didn't need the door to open automatically. If you select the UV sterilization and hot air drying options, the moisture from the washed dishes is blown away, and the UV lamp kills mold and bacteria, so the automatic door opening function was not necessary in the first place. This was the part I was most worried about, but I felt that LG had done a lot of research on this part. I was also very satisfied with the delivery service, and I was especially worried that it would be noisy because it was early in the morning, but the installation was done quietly, and I was happy that they even did the final cleanup and provided a friendly explanation.

Sentence (English): FIT & FINISH: The recessed handle of this DW has some flex around it where plastic, stainless, and chrome coexist.
Comments (English): [ OK But Could Be Improved ] || ---------------- || FIT & FINISH: The recessed handle of this DW has some flex around it where plastic, stainless, and chrome coexist. The stainless front panel flexes in & out if you press a hand palm against it, making it feel cheap rather than high end solid manufacturing. When closing the door, the snap of the mechanism has a noticeable plastic noise to it, but rather than imparting confidence, it feels very plastic and you may wonder if you should try to shut it more gently to prevent breakage. This is not a soft-close mechanism by any means, instead it sounds harsh. There have been cases where the latch mech has broken. Again, not the most solid feeling appliance in real world use. The stainless front shows markings where it was held by styrofoam, wood, and plastic wrap. Time will tell if these markings disappear after multiple cleanings but it's disappointing to not have a pristine front stainless finish after unwrapping. INSTALLATION: I originally thought the 800 would come with the AquaStop feature which has a small catch drain beneath the water supply inlet to catch any future leak at that junction and pump it away, and alert to the leak. When the unit was delivered, there was no water hose attached (which is seen in online research but is only in the EU markets), and there's nothing to catch a leak at this crucial point of water hookup to the appliance. So there's no AquaStop on this 800 model in the US market. The water supply inlet is the same size as a garden hose hookup, and those always eventually leak. And the water hookup is in the back of the unit—in earlier models the water supply was in the front, behind the kick plate. The male water supply threads are plastic (brass would be preferred) so over tightening is a major concern. Highly recommend installing a dishwasher drain pan from Killarneymetals-dot-com to ensure any leaks in the back will be directed to the front so you can see them easily. Also a smart leak detector like the Eve Water Guard is an excellent idea. The top (or side) cabinet brackets are the only point of physically securing the unit, but the brackets have a ton of slop in them. The metal brackets are inserted into a slots, and tabs are bent downward, but the brackets can move side-to-side because the slots are wider than brackets. So the unit can still wiggle around if it really wants to. The securing engineering could be greatly improved. I'd suggest designing two extendible pads that would push out at the very bottom sides after the unit is in place – to push against the left and right cabinet walls. Like side leveling feet. This would keep the unit centered, prevent side-to-side movement, and improve the solidity of the unit. DWs slide into cabinetry and are usually only attached with two small wood screws either at the top or sides. But pulling the door open takes a bit of force, and closing the spring loaded door has force behind it as well. Those two repeated torques can wiggle a unit out of place easily since it's not securely bolted down to anything. For leveling the unit, the plastic front leveling feet are a disaster. They require an installer to insert a screwdriver into thin little slots in the round plastic feet, but the plastic is soft, so the slots deform making the process of leveling the unit frustratingly difficult, with plastic getting chewed up in the process. The screwdriver cannot get good purchase with the slots. Plus there aren't enough slots – an inserted screwdriver cannot make enough of a turn to expose the next slot easily. Who on earth thought this design was the best solution? It's so bad. Similar for the back leveling screw, soft plastic is used here again with a large screwdriver slot, serious force is needed to move the back foot up/down, the plastic slot deforms easily, more unnecessary frustration. A few metal parts in crucial areas (with hex or Torx instead of slots) would go a long way instead of all the cheap plastic everywhere. And the sound insulation batt is not adhered or keyed into the unit well so upon sliding the unit in, you will not be confident the insulation stayed in the proper place. OPERATION: The DW performs well. It cleans sufficiently, the 3 racks accommodate loads well, and the Crystal Dry does a decent job of drying. But it takes a long time. It would be nice if there was a faster option (sanitize mode? ) where there's no particulates (sink-rinsed dishes) and a user basically wants to sanitize and dry the load. Commercial DWs take a few minutes for this process, whereas a normal load in a Bosch 800 is 2 hr 40 min. There is a "Speed 60” cycle but it doesn't get the load dry, glasses are dripping wet at the end, so it's not useful. The Home Connect app has OK features but there's room for improvement. Connecting to the appliance can be spotty – go to the app, says the DW isn't connected, try again, it's connected now, no rhyme or reason for it. The layout of the app could employ smarter use of screen real estate to lessen the need for scrolling around. A 1/3 screen height image of a generic DW interior is definitely not the best use of space in an app where a user comes to control or monitor an appliance. Completely redo the UX in general. Alerting to low levels of detergent or rinse aid are welcome conveniences. And scheduling for late night washings, remote starts, and cycle complete data are all useful. But in general, the app UX and layout should be improved.

Comments (English): Read the user manual carefully before use. First of all, the price is reasonable. Although it is freestanding, to avoid bending over when putting in and taking out dishes, I removed the large storage unit inside the tall cabinet and adjusted the position of the small storage unit that was placed above it. If it is a standard sink with a width of 600, it fits perfectly if you just remove the sink and adjust the position. It is a rocket installation, but I installed it myself. Since the sink faucet is recessed in the wall, I didn't remove the inlet hose from the sink side. Instead, I took a 6mm water purifier hose from the laundry faucet and connected it to the dishwasher inlet hose with a 6mm 15A conversion gender. Just like a washing machine, I connected the inlet to the water and the drain to the sewer. Since there is a drying function, you need to set the time and turn it on to dry the water well. The cutlery basket is made of plastic, and the fixing ring part came broken. Since it does not affect use, I am going to use it as is. For now, several domestic dishwasher companies, such as SK and Cuckoo, sell Midea products. Since it's OEM manufactured, the functions are pretty much the same. Coupang also provides after-sales service, so it's trustworthy. I'm not sure about the durability yet because I haven't used it for a long time. I set the drying function to 5 minutes, and the dishes are dry, but there is still moisture on the dishwasher rack and inside. I think if I adjust the drying time to 10 minutes, there won't be any moisture. I'll have to try that.

Sentence (English): I recently purchased a Samsung BESPOKE countertop dishwasher.
Comments (English): I recently purchased a Samsung BESPOKE countertop dishwasher. Once installed in the kitchen, I found it incredibly convenient. I was initially a bit concerned about the space, but the clean design blended well with the kitchen decor. ### **Washing Performance**. The cleaning power, which is the most important factor, was truly beyond my expectations. It cleaned not only plates and cups but also greasy food containers thoroughly. Perhaps because the upper and lower washing blades worked well, even stubborn stains were easily removed. ### **Ease of Use**. I liked that it is easy to operate and offers various washing courses to choose from depending on the situation. I particularly appreciated the 'Tub Cleaning' function, which allows for hygienic maintenance. ### **Capacity**. As it is a 6-place setting, it was just right for our family of four. We were able to fit plenty of cups and plates, allowing us to handle a day's worth of dishwashing in one go. ### **Drying Function**. While the drying function was slightly lacking for plastic dishes, it dried most items well. I think it would be even more effective if you adjusted the capacity accordingly. ### **Overall Review**. Overall, it is a very satisfying product. My stress from washing dishes has decreased significantly, and it makes me feel good to have the kitchen always kept clean. If you are considering a dishwasher, I highly recommend this product!
Comments (Original): 최근에 삼성 BESPOKE 카운터탑 식기세척기를 구입했어요. 주방에 설치하고 나니 정말 편리하더라고요. 처음에 공간이 좀 걱정됐는데, 디자인이 깔끔해서 주방 인테리어와 잘 어울렸어요.### **세척 성능**가장 중요한 세척력은 정말 기대 이상이었어요. 접시나 컵은 물론이고, 기름기가 많은 반찬통도 깨끗하게 세척해주더라고요. 상단과 하단의 세척 날개가 잘 작동해서 그런지, 찌든 때도 쉽게 제거되었어요. ### **사용 편의성**조작이 간편하고 다양한 세척 코스가 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있는 점이 마음에 들었어요. 특히 ‘통세척’ 기능이 있어서 위생적으로 관리할 수 있는 게 좋았어요. ### **수용량**6인용이라 4인 가족인 저희에게는 딱 적당했어요. 컵과 접시를 넉넉하게 넣을 수 있어서 하루 설거지를 한 번에 해결할 수 있었답니다. ### **건조 기능**건조 기능은 플라스틱 식기에는 조금 아쉬운 점이 있었지만, 대부분의 식기는 잘 건조되었어요. 용량을 잘 맞춰서 사용하면 더 효과적일 것 같아요.### **총평**전반적으로 매우 만족스러운 제품이에요. 설거지 스트레스가 많이 줄어들고 주방이 항상 깔끔하게 유지되니까 기분도 좋아지네요. 식기세척기를 고민 중이라면 이 제품 정말 추천해요!

Comments (English): [ Media automatic door opening dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The brand Midea was unfamiliar to me, but it turns out it is a product from a major conglomerate. As a global company, it ranks 245th among the largest corporations in the U.S., exports to 200 countries, and operates 34 production plants worldwide. Coupang directly imports and sells products from such a solid company, and they even offer a whopping 2-year warranty on after-sales service. However, with this automatic door opening feature, you don't need to wait; the dishes are dried automatically, allowing you to fill your soup and rice bowls with fluffy, dry food. Therefore, this feature should not be overlooked. When purchasing a dishwasher, it would be a good idea to keep in mind whether this feature is available. With its clean design and compact size, I highly recommend this Midea product. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

I feel obliged to rate the dishwasher 4 stars instead of 5 stars because I do not know yet how reliable it will be overtime. And given that is one of the most important factors for me in rating a product, I urge Bosch to ask me again what I think in 3 years.

Sentence (English): This is our 4th dishwasher in 17 years and it's hands down, The Best.

Dishes come out extremely clean AND dry, which is a nice surpise since the industry stopped using heating elemets for drying, The mobile app is handy when you're getting to know the dishwasher. We loved the cycle customization wizard and it helped us achieve the results we were hoping for without having to get too deep into the knitty gritty of every possible feature and setting (of which there are many). So far, the value for our money is worth it. We were torn between the 800 and the model up: to be honest, I'm not sure how the results we have with this machine could be improved - even with more money. We had to replace a 3-year old LG dishwasher that had a similar price point: I wouln't be surprised if 10% more in price yields 500% more in lifespan. Keep an eye out for sales at Costco. Just a great machine.

Sentence (English): The installer claimed that our power outlet is not up to 2020 codes (our house was built in 2016 and a dishwasher was purchased and installed by Costco in 2021) and claimed that both a GFGI power outlet is required and a new air gap must be installed even though our existing air gap is still in very good condition.
Comments (English): [ Bad Services - Not Recommended ] || ---------------- || The installer claimed that our power outlet is not up to 2020 codes (our house was built in 2016 and a dishwasher was purchased and installed by Costco in 2021) and claimed that both a GFGI power outlet is required and a new air gap must be installed even though our existing air gap is still in very good condition. They charged me $185 for installing the GFGI power outlet next to our existing power outlet (which took him less than 5 minutes to do it). I don't think that this high charge is justified for such a simple task. They charged us $130 for air gap which Costco only credited us $100 so that we ended up paying $215 for installing the dishwasher. We purchased a dishwasher through Costco.com in November 2021 and that dishwasher was installed without any additional charge. If GFGI power outlet is 2020 codes, they should have already required it in 2021. - Compared with the 2021's experience, today's installation charge is a total ripoff. They claimed the $185 charge of installing GPGI power outlet is Costco price. - None of those costs or any warning about potential occurrence of those costs were listed on Costco.com when I purchased this dishwasher. It effectively added more than $200 to a dishwasher that listed for ~$600. - The installer claimed that someone from Costco should have called us prior to the installation to discuss the codes etc., which we have never received. - We offered to pay through Costco, but the installers threatened that they "are not leaving until it's paid". I have been a costco executive member for 24 years now, I am very unhappy about today's experience. If a new air gap and GFGI power outlet are required, those conditions should be clearly stated on Costco.com. Costco should also make sure that Costco authorized installer charge customer reasonable and fair price and not rip-off customer like today's case.

Sentence (English): I rated the Bosch 300 4-stars for a real reason!
Comments (English): [ Clean Dishes, with Hidden Costs and Drippy Wetness ] || ---------------- || I rated the Bosch 300 4-stars for a real reason! Here's the good news: This dishwasher will get get your dishes clean, clean, clean, really clean. And there is plenty of room inside to fit all those dirty dishes that have been piling up for a week! One of the greatest features of this machine is the utensil rack. In this rack all of your forks, spoon, knives, etc. are placed and they get clean, super clean! I like this feature, very effective. This is a great machine, but be careful, here is the bad news: after the machine is done washing the dishes, the inside of the machine does not dry out. To dry out the inside, you need to prop open the door immediately upon cycle end, while the the inside is still hot (hint: use the extra dry feature to get the following affect), and let the moisture/steam escape. If you don't do this, the inside of the machine will be drippy wet! Not the dishes, the walls of the machine. For a $1000+ cost dishwasher, why couldn't Bosch fix this problem? This is a real problem that the inherent excellent German engineering did not resolve! Why not? That's a rhetorical question. Costco has nothing to do with this problem, but they need to tell Bosch to find a fix for the wetness. Now here is a big Costco challenge with this machine, and all the other dishwashers that Costco sells: a hidden $500 cost that Costco tries to slip in and hope you don't realize it's coming. Costco claims free installation, and that is a good thing. They'll even have the installer drag off the old dishwasher. But, Costco, in the small print says "installation parts are not included in the "free" installation. If you don't have the correct water line, in-line aerator or city code compliant electrical connection for the new dishwasher, the installer will have those parts and will install them for $500, parts and labor. Note: if your house is old, your electrical connections are not code compliant! So that $1400 Bosch dishwasher that you just bought, the one that stays wet inside after the dish-washing cycle is complete, will cost you $1900, given a few bucks plus/minus! Given the wetness and the unseen additional hidden costs, I didn't return the machine, it was too big of a hassle. It did get installed, it does get the dishes really clean, and the old machine I didn't have to deal with. But, it is an expensive price to pay to get your dishes clean. If I had known about the wetness and added parts/labor costs, I would not have bought the machine. But I bought it, am keeping it, and enjoying the really clean dishes the Bosch 300 produces! Shame on you Costco, you knew about these problems and kept them a secret. Not how Costco normally operates, but I got a great dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Sentence (English): As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage.
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Sentence (English): So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful!
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Sentence (English): After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly.
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. I often refer to other people's reviews when making purchases, so I'm leaving this review to help others. Sentence (English): I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough.
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. I often refer to other people's reviews when making purchases, so I'm leaving this review to help others. Sentence (English): Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes.
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Sentence (English): I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Sentence (English): I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow!
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. I often refer to other people's reviews when making purchases, so I'm leaving this review to help others. Sentence (English): The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. -------------------------------------------
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24 Delivery Date: 2024/09/25 Review Date: 2024/10/04 It's nice that the installation is easy. The Media 6-person dishwasher is said to minimize the perforation area with a small 10mm hole size, reducing the installation burden, and the technician really did install the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit nervous about installing a new dishwasher, but it was nice that it was installed without causing any major damage. You can add dishes mid-cycle (with a caveat). Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and then press the same button again to continue. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already run far enough, the additional dishes may become contaminated, preventing the already washed dishes from being washed properly. (2) Hot steam may cause burns when the door is opened. ***Therefore, it's better to add it quickly when the cycle has just started, and if some time has passed, it's better to wash it next time. 3. It has an automatic door opening function. People who have already used dishwashers always emphasize that the door opening function after the cycle is complete is important. So, I think we can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help dry the dishes quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it's for 6 people, but surprisingly, many of the dishes I used before were dishwasher-safe, and since we usually only have 2-3 people eating, even a 6-person dishwasher is more than enough. Of course, the reason the dishwasher is so big is probably because it has to accommodate not only traditional dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, and more! Still, I'm so glad to have the help of the dishwasher lady, and I'm really happy that it saves me time washing dishes. I've definitely seen a water saving effect from using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, the regular cycle used less than 5 liters of water after the entire wash cycle. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing tub, but it didn't overflow! The dishwasher user manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on how dirty the dishes are, soaking some of them separately before adding them can help improve the cleaning effect. ------------------------------------------- This was my actual review. Comments (English): [ False Advertising-Pre Soaking Needed To Clean ] || ---------------- || I like the dishwasher when it actually cleans properly. It is advertised as not needing to soak, scrub, or rinse dishes but I am finding that to be false advertising. I have only had the dishwasher about a month. I usually soak items before moving to the dishwasher but I decided to test it by not soaking as usual the last couple of loads. It doesn't clean well if not soaked first. It leaves food and residue behind. Whatever is left behind is baked on by the heated dry cycle. I have not had any issues with the heating part like some reviewers. I haven't even needed to try the longer dry cycle because the short one works so well. I wish it cleaned without soaking as advertised. I have tried my usual Cascade Platinum Plus and the recommended Finish Ultimate but both left it less than clean for un-soaked items. I like having the top rack but the tray for utensils on the right side doesn't let them get items cleaned as well as the side with no tray. Maybe the tray doesn't allow enough water flow. Yesterday after removing a roast from a crock pot I waited a few hours to load it in to the dishwasher. I did not rinse, soak, or scrub and it left a white residue and particles all on the interior of it. It was placed on the bottom rack to the back of the wash tub. It was on the PowerBlast cycle with short heat dry cycle. Water is plenty hot at nearly 140 degrees before it enters the dishwasher to be heated even more. There is no reason this should not be clean. It also wouldn't remove dry scrambled egg from a small skillet. Particularly where the handle attachments are on the inside of the skillet. I am a bit disappointed. Too late to return but would be too much trouble anyway. I guess I will have to go back to soaking dishes before washing, which is unfortunate. I was hoping to not have to do that any longer. I am putting "No" for "do you recommend" in this review since it is required. If pre soaking wasn't needed I would give this 4 or 5 stars and recommend. Otherwise, I would love it because it seems well made, dries well, and is very quiet, and can fit more items with 3 racks with one being adjustable. That is very handy.

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------.
