Sentence (English): So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful!
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Sentence (English): I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting!
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order Date: 2024/09/24. Delivery Date: 2024/09/25. Review Date: 2024/10/04. 1. It is great that the installation is not a burden. They said the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the cutout area with a small 10mm hole size, and indeed, the technician installed the water supply pipe through a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a bit apprehensive about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing significant damage. 2. You can add dishes in the middle of the cycle (with precautions). Even if the wash cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to continue. However, please note the following: (1) If the cycle has already progressed significantly, depending on the soiling level of the newly added dishes, the dishes already washed may become contaminated, potentially preventing the newly added dishes from being cleaned thoroughly. (2) You may suffer burns from hot steam when opening the door. Therefore, it is best to add items quickly shortly after the cycle begins, and if some time has passed, it is better to wash them next time. It features automatic door opening. Those who already use dishwashers often emphasized that the feature where the door opens after the wash is finished is important. So, I think we can say that the Midea 6-place setting dishwasher is small but powerful! After the cycle ends, the door automatically opens with a "click" to help speed up drying. Once drying is completely finished in 10 minutes, a short melody plays to indicate that the wash is complete. I thought it would be quite small since it is a 6-place setting! Surprisingly, I didn't have many dishwasher-safe dishes among the ones I used previously, and since there are usually only 2-3 family members eating, the 6-place setting was more than enough. Of course, the reason people say "bigger is better" when it comes to dishwashers is probably because you need to load not only typical-shaped dishes but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, food containers, and so on! Still, I am very happy to receive ample help from the dishwasher, and I am delighted that my dishwashing time has truly been reduced. I have confirmed that using the dishwasher definitely saves water. Even when I put in more dishes than I usually do by hand, I found that the total water used after the standard cycle was complete was less than 5 liters. I use a smaller-than-average dishwashing basin, but when I filled it with water, it didn't overflow! The dishwasher manual states that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of soiling, soaking some dishes separately before putting them in will yield even better cleaning results. -----------------------------------------. This concludes my review based on actual use. I tend to refer to other people's reviews a lot when making purchases, so I am leaving this review to be helpful as well. Sentence (English): This Samsung DW80R9950US has a large 3/4" water inlet unlike the 3/8" connections for all my previous dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Be careful if you have an on demand water heater ] || ---------------- || This Samsung DW80R9950US has a large 3/4" water inlet unlike the 3/8" connections for all my previous dishwashers. If the valve feeding the dishwasher is just opened up, the Samsung can draw water at a rate that will cause the on demand system to flame out resulting in cold wash water. Adjust the valve so that the on demand system is running near capacity but not over. If the washer is started in the morning before hot water has has been flowing, cold water will enter before the on demand system can fill the pipes with hot water. I just run the tap until hot water is in the pipes before turning on the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I love this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Great unit! --*if far from sink, Bosch hose ext req ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher! Highly, highly recommend! [**Please see my note below about the special Bosch drain hose extension required if your dishwasher is not directly adjacent to your sink and/or on the right side, if that applies to you] I spent a lot of time reading about the different series (100, 300, 500, 800) and trying to decide between them, after research dishwashers in Consumer Reports in the first place. I've had Maytag, Whirlpool, GE, etc., before this Bosch, and haven't really ever been happy with anything. The Top 10 or more ranked dishwashers were all Bosch, and they came highly recommended by friends, so that' why we went that direction. I settled on the 500 series because I decided I didn't need what the 800 series and above offered in terms of bells and whistles, but I liked the leak guard/protections and the better drying capabilities of the 500 series over the 300. I'm incredibly happy with the decision. Pros: 1. This is much quieter. We can watch movies in the same room and it doesn't interfere at all. 2. It cleans excellently and dries much better than our previous dishwashers. It also pops the door once the cycle is complete, so dishes can further air dry. I tend to run it over night, so that's super helpful. The red light turns off when the cycle is done, too. And if you use the app, then it will also alert you that the cycle is complete. 4. I don't have to worry about leaks because of the system safeguards that Bosch and the 500 series have built in. Maybe not a big deal to you, but I've had so many previous appliances leak I've lost count. The installer said the tiniest attempt at a leak will trigger this and not allow it, and I'm thrilled that means I won't end up with water damage to my floor. 5. I love the 3rd rack. I didn't think we'd get much use out of it, but it's awesome. For straws and medicine cups and water bottle lids and all the weird stuff that we had to prop up in places before. We get way more use out of it than I thought we would. 6. I love that you can adjust the tines. It's very easy to put them up and down, and to adjust how you load things. I honestly don't understand all the people complaining about struggling to fit as much or figuring out how to load it. It's amazing. And the adjustable rack heights are so great. A few things to note (I won't even call them cons, because I don't really think they are): --use the rinsing agent and the recommended settings (read the online manual) if you're worried about drying. This doesn't dry any worse--and I think TONS better--than our previous dishwashers, but for people who've had previous Boschs and complained about issues with newer models, I think if you follow the instructions you'll be fine. Plastic is never going to be bone dry. Maybe those people aren't used to washing plastic in a dishwasher? --I don't love the app. I do wish it was easier to change the setting right on the dishwasher itself. It's fine. Do I love this about it? No. But I'll survive. I just mainly run it on the factory preset which gets the job done great. I/m just irritated that any of my appliances use apps at all. **Please, please hire a competent installer to install your dishwasher. If your dishwasher is even slightly further away from your sink (and ours barely is. It's perhaps 1.5 ft away, but it's on the left side, which makes the hookup slightly further away). If that's the case, you will need an extension hose, and the only extension hose you can use with a Bosch dishwasher is the specialty Bosch extension drain hose, and the likelihood that the retailer you purchase your Bosch unit from will NOT know that is HIGH. And if you do not hire your own competent installer, or if you go with a store supplier installer, then the likelihood that they will not know either (and might try to use a universal extension drain hose) is also high. I cannot emphasize this enough. The hose extension is separate from the "universal dishwasher hookup kit." So the dishwasher is amazing, but you need to make sure you hire a trained and competent installer to install it correctly so that you can actually use your new dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Finally, a great product! ] || ---------------- || I built and owned my home for 12 years. In those years, I've been through three dishwashers. I believed that we're just living in times where products are no longer made well. My plumber friend suggested that I try a Bosch. He'd mentioned that the ones he's installed in other homes are well made, efficient and quiet. I wasn't familiar with Bosch, but we needed a new dishwasher after the last two fizzled out in only two years. This was frustrating after having spent so much on them with only a one year warranty for each. Do products only hold up for a year now? Our friend installed the Bosch dishwasher. That night, we turned it on and. "Do you hear that? " I said to my mother. "Hear what? " She replied. "Exactly! Not a sound coming from the machine! " The next morning, I opened the door and to my surprise, the dishes were clean. Shocking. I started testing its power as days went by because I couldn't believe its efficiency. I had the nerve to put a pan with baked on grease in there. Expecting the worst, the pan came out mostly clean with a small amount of dark crust around the edges. I prepared myself with a knife to do some scraping. At first touch, the crust easily flaked right off. What? Of course I have no intention of performing tests such as these anymore, but it has restored my faith in productivity. I am confident that I have a machine that will do its job and last way past its warranty. I am grateful to my friend for the recommendation and for Bosch creating a great product.

Sentence (English): Firstly, for those of you who may at first glance dismiss or overlook this model as there appears to be no obvious separate "Pre-Rinse only" function, please reconsider and read page 22 of the User Manual.
Comments (English): [ Love it! ] || ---------------- || Firstly, for those of you who may at first glance dismiss or overlook this model as there appears to be no obvious separate "Pre-Rinse only" function, please reconsider and read page 22 of the User Manual. A separate pre-rinse programme can be found under the “Favourite" programme selector. This model is super quiet and is aesthetically pleasing giving my old kitchen a bit of lift. Also no more water hammer when it is filling. You hardly know it is on. The wash results on all programme options provided as standard with the machine are very good. Dirty dishes in and super clean and dry out which is what you want. I cannot comment on the functionality of the dishwasher connected to the Bosch app/internet as I have not and do not intend on connecting my dishwasher to the Internet. The reason is that I have massive privacy concerns around connecting any appliance to the Internet – particularly if smart meters have been forced on you and their back-end capability. Do your own research. Excellent value for money – after some considerable research, I found that to get the same features in other high-end dishwashers you would be paying considerably more. I have previously owned and continue to own Bosch washing machines and have found the brand to have excellent features and quality and offers longevity of reliable service. I hope this review helps with your purchase choice.

Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for 3 months and I have to say it looks gorgeous and works well for our family of 5, but it is missing one key component.

There is NO indicator that the dishwasher has completed its cycle. Yes, it locks the door so that you cannot open it in the middle of a cycle, but there are times that I go to load the dishwasher, but I can't immediately tell if the dishes within are clean or not. When multiple family members are loading the dishwasher, this becomes an issue. So keep that in mind. Also, I love the independent drawers, but the bottom drawer can be a bit of a pain to unload since it is so close to the ground. I'd suggest you save those cycles for running larger pots & pans so you aren't bending over too much.

Sentence (English): Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher 6-Place capacity, Blue, MDWMT0601BL-A-KR, On-site Installation.
Comments (English): [ It's a thoughtful gift that lets you rest on the sofa instead of doing the dishes. ] || ---------------- || Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher 6-Place Capacity, Blue, MDWMT0601BL-A-KR, On-site Installation. Overall Satisfaction. General Review. I installed this Midea dishwasher at my parents' house. Although we are a large family, my mom and dad usually live alone, so they don't wash dishes all at once but accumulate them to do themselves. As a result, they tend to do it haphazardly, and burnt-on food particles like chili powder don't come off easily. I already use a dishwasher in my newlywed home, so I am well aware of its advantages and really wanted to give one to my parents. I had previously bought a countertop model from another brand for them, but the technician returned it, saying they couldn't install it separately because we were already using a water purifier. However, the technician installed the Midea dishwasher perfectly (with no extra charge), so my parents are now able to use it too! Regarding dishwasher detergent, since it is a countertop model and uses a 6-place capacity product, it doesn't fit a huge amount of dishes, so I cut the container in half to use it. I was recommended liquid or powder detergents, but instead of using a separate rinse aid, I used the mini tablet product that comes with it. It cleaned very thoroughly without leaving any detergent residue. It feels like it cleans even better because the water jets rotate both above and below, not just at the bottom. Also, there is a feature to add dishes during the wash cycle, so I can put everything in without forgetting anything. The best feature is the door opening function once the cycle is finished. The product I used before didn't open the door automatically, so if I occasionally forgot to leave it open, a lot of water would build up inside. Now, with the automatic door opening, the remaining heat inside helps the dishes dry much better after just about 10 minutes! I am so glad that my parents can get one chore done a little more comfortably. My mom couldn't get used to it at first since she can lean back on the sofa and rest during the time she would normally be doing the dishes, but now she loves it. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

After using this fancy new dishwasher here are the PROS and CONS:PROS: the settings are all hidden on top of the door. CONS: I don't use the silverware basket and have removed it entirely. I found that food from the dishes blows all over the silverware and the silverware comes out with baked on crud from the other dishes. I place the silverware on the top rack where they all come much cleaner. It doesn't do quite as good a job as my Kenmore. My Kenmore had many more jets compared to this Bosch and I think that made all the difference. I'd give this d/w a 90% rating out of 100 in terms of how the dishes turn out. Sometimes I have to rewash. I never had to rewash in my Kenmore. Overall I am satisfied and I've made adjustments so that I can get the best out of this dishwasher. Would definitely recommend.

He adjusted the height and level by tightening the screws on the legs of the dishwasher, and he meticulously paid attention to the aesthetics, so I was very satisfied. The sink of the apartment I am moving into is made of metal, but when I visited the store to buy a dishwasher, there was no metal color. I gave up and lived because I had to pay almost twice as much for an imported brand to buy a metal color, but when it was almost a year since I moved in, an advertisement for a metal color caught my eye, and since it was LG, which was a new product, I paid right away. The technician came on the desired date, and although our sink needed work, we had to have it installed the next day, but the technician was so meticulous and kind that he explained everything in detail and took care of everything, so the impression was doubled. Also, after the installation was over, while listening to the technician's explanation, I heard that I had to add salt once a week, and while purchasing, I learned that only LG has a dishwasher water softener, so I thought that purchasing an LG dishwasher was an excellent choice.

Sentence (English): I want to start by saying this dishwasher itself is amazing!
Comments (English): [ Stylish design and extra space ] || ---------------- || I want to start by saying this dishwasher itself is amazing! I love the extra drawer that helps keep the smaller items contained. It's amazing that they were able to provide this extra space with the same general size format of a standard dishwasher. The design is sleek, and i really like the stylized handle. The red sides on the handle weren't my favorite as they didn't match my kitchen, but Kitchenaid made the inserts very easy to remove for the purpose of paint-matching your kitchen. The controls are pretty easy to operate, albeit very sensitive (you can accidentally hit one after making your selection). The unit comes with a fair amount of sound dampening insulation so it helps tremendously with noise levels.Most of the things that i think could stand improvement relate to the installation itself. The only thing with the dishwasher i think could use is more secure insulation. The way it is loosely covering it makes it conducive to bunching up when being installed in the tight space usually alloted for a dishwasher. When it came to the installation, the unit was delivered on time and with ease. However, the installers refused to utilize my air gap that was installed, choosing to bypass it instead because they didn't have the correct clamp. I even offered one of my own as i keep these type things on hand in my garage, yet they still refused. This led to me having to uninstall and reinstall the drain lines myself to make sure this necessary feature was installed (an air gap ensures there is no backup from a garbage disposal into a dishwasher's drain lines). Fortunately I have the experience to do this on my own. Next, they failed to use the hole drilled through the inner cabinet wall to route my water line, and instead ran it through a cutout for my sink. This led to the water line being stressed and squished between the dishwasher and cabinet instead of laying nicely behind the unit like it should. The buttons/controls for the machine are on the top of the door instead of the front. Nice clean concept, except the installers set the height at the highest level. This placed the controls 1/8 inch away from the countertop making seeing and using the controls impossible. This led to me having to pull the entire unit out to set the legs to proper height. The final mishap of the installers came from their trial run to make sure it all worked. Well, they left the paper tags inside the dishwasher. It took over an hour removing all of the filter screens and flushing the drain lines to remove clumps of wet paper. All in all, the dishwasher is great. It works fantastically, it looks great in the kitchen i am currently remodeling, and the extra drawer is a fantastic upgrade. The installers could use more training, though.
